name: Helix Integration
main_workout:
🧽 Soft Tissue Preparation 2'

  • Self-massage — 30 sec per thigh using your palms; apply gentle pressure over muscle, avoiding the knees.

  • Self-massage — 30 sec per upper arm and shoulder using the opposite hand; avoid direct pressure over joints.

🔥 Activation 4'

  • 8 reps {{exercise:1167:dynamic chest stretch}} — tempo 2 sec open, 2 sec return; use an easy range; rest 15 sec.

  • 8 reps {{exercise:1428:wrist circles}} — tempo 2 sec per rotation, four each direction; rest 15 sec.

  • 8 reps {{exercise:1422:pelvic tilt into bridge}} — tempo 2 sec lift, 1 sec gentle hold, 2 sec lower; rest 20 sec.

  • 8 reps {{exercise:clamshell:Clamshell}} — tempo 2 sec lift, 2 sec lower; keep effort easy; rest 20 sec.

💪 Main Workout (REPS & SETS)

Complete all four sets of each exercise before moving on. Allow approximately 45 minutes, including the prescribed recovery after every set and transitions within those recovery periods. Keep 2–3 clean reps in reserve; this is deliberate strength practice, not a circuit.

  • 4 sets × 3 reps {{exercise:0662:push-up}} — tempo 2-sec lower, 1-sec pause, rise with fast intent while keeping hands grounded, 1-sec reset; rest 150 sec. Alternate the advancing knee, keep its travel modest and prevent trunk rotation; alternate your starting side each set.

  • 4 sets × 30 sec {{exercise:0705:side bridge v. 2}} — tempo 1-sec controlled leg lift, 1-sec hold, 2-sec lower, 1-sec reset; rest 150 sec. Alternate legs and your starting side each set; keep the pelvis level and use only a pain-free shoulder position.

  • 4 sets × 3 reps per side {{exercise:0274:crunch floor}} — tempo 1-sec controlled lift, 1-sec hold, 2-sec lower, 1-sec reset; rest 150 sec after both sides. Use the floor-supported position without elevating either foot on furniture; keep the supporting shoulder steady and the movement small.

  • 4 sets × 3 reps {{exercise:0872:reverse crunch}} — tempo 1-sec smooth rise, 1-sec pause, 2-sec lower, 1-sec reset; rest 150 sec. Keep feet unanchored, gently draw the heels toward you without sliding, and avoid momentum or neck pulling.

⚡ Finisher (REPS & SETS)

One low-fatigue accessory set per movement, approximately 2½ minutes total. These are separate quality sets, not conditioning; retain at least 3 reps in reserve.

  • 1 set × 30 sec {{exercise:0705:side bridge v. 2}} — tempo 1-sec lift, 1-sec hold, 2-sec lower, 1-sec reset; rest 30 sec. Alternate legs without letting the hips drop.

  • 1 set × 3 reps per side {{exercise:0274:crunch floor}} — tempo 1-sec lift, 1-sec hold, 2-sec lower, 1-sec reset; rest 30 sec after both sides. Maintain the same floor-supported setup and comfortable range.

  • 1 set × 3 reps {{exercise:0872:reverse crunch}} — tempo 1-sec smooth rise, 1-sec pause, 2-sec lower, 1-sec reset; rest 30 sec. Keep the feet unanchored and finish before technique changes.

🧘 Cool Down 4'

  • 1 set × 30 sec per side {{exercise:0613:lying (side) quads stretch}} — hold still at mild tension and breathe out into the position; rest 5 sec between sides.

  • 1 set × 30 sec per side {{exercise:0669:rear deltoid stretch}} — hold gently without bouncing and breathe out into the position; rest 5 sec between sides.

  • 1 set × 45 sec {{exercise:1511:hamstring stretch}} — hold a comfortable position without rounding forcefully; breathe out into the position; rest 5 sec.

  • 2 min Box breathing — 4 in, 4 hold, 4 out, 4 hold

name: Iron Current
main_workout:
🧽 Soft Tissue Preparation 2'

  • Foam roll upper back — 1 × 60 sec, slow passes with your head supported; avoid the neck and lower back; rest 0 sec.

  • Foam roll outer upper back — 1 × 30 sec per side, gentle passes without direct pressure into the armpit; rest 0 sec.

🔥 Activation 4'

  • 8 reps {{exercise:1167:dynamic chest stretch}} — open and return over 4 sec per repetition, using a comfortable range; rest 15 sec.

  • 30 sec {{exercise:0669:rear deltoid stretch}} — gently enter for 2 sec and release for 2 sec, without a sustained hold; rest 15 sec.

  • 8 reps {{exercise:bird-dog:Bird Dog}} — gently enter for 2 sec and release for 2 sec; keep ribs relaxed and shoulders comfortable; rest 15 sec.

  • 8 reps {{exercise:1428:wrist circles}} — move both wrists together, taking 2 sec per repetition; rest 15 sec.

💪 Main Workout (REPS & SETS)

Complete each exercise block before moving on; these are straight sets, not supersets. Use a securely fitted loading belt with plates, leaving 2 repetitions in reserve. Blocks three and four repeat the established movements with approximately 5–10% less added load. Budget approximately 44 minutes including the written recovery periods; use the final recovery of each block to change position.

  • 4 sets × 3 reps {{exercise:2330:cable lat pulldown full range of motion}} — externally loaded; tempo 2-sec lower, brief half-second pause, lift with explosive intent without swinging, 1-sec reset; rest 150 sec after every set. Use a comfortable shoulder-width grip and keep your neck neutral.

  • 4 sets × 3 reps {{exercise:0180:cable low seated row}} — externally loaded; tempo 2-sec lower, brief half-second pause, lift with explosive intent, 1-sec reset; rest 150 sec after every set. Descend only as far as your shoulders remain comfortable and controlled.

  • 4 sets × 4 reps {{exercise:0585:lever leg extension}} — externally loaded back-off block; tempo 2-sec lower, brief half-second pause, lift with explosive intent without swinging, 1-sec reset; rest 150 sec after every set. Reduce added load enough to retain 2 repetitions in reserve.

  • 4 sets × 4 reps {{exercise:0861:cable seated row}} — externally loaded back-off block; tempo 2-sec lower, brief half-second pause, lift with explosive intent, 1-sec reset; rest 150 sec after every set. Preserve the same comfortable depth throughout.

⚡ Finisher (REPS & SETS)

One low-fatigue set per line, performed separately—not a circuit or a speed test. Allow approximately 3 minutes. Use substantially less added load than in the main work and finish every set with at least 2 repetitions available.

  • 1 set × 3 reps {{exercise:2330:cable lat pulldown full range of motion}} — lightly externally loaded; tempo 2-sec lower, brief pause, smooth strong lift, 1-sec reset; rest 45 sec.

  • 1 set × 3 reps {{exercise:0579:lever front pulldown}} — lightly externally loaded; tempo 2-sec lower, brief pause, smooth strong lift, 1-sec reset; rest 45 sec.

  • 1 set × 5 reps {{exercise:1452:lever seated crunch}} — hold a light plate against your chest only if comfortable; tempo 2-sec lower, 1-sec pause, 2-sec controlled lift; rest 45 sec. Keep your feet grounded and avoid pulling on your neck.

🧘 Cool Down 4'

  • 1 set × 45 sec {{exercise:1271:chest and front of shoulder stretch}} — hold gently without bouncing, breathe out into the position; rest 10 sec.

  • 1 set × 30 sec per side {{exercise:0669:rear deltoid stretch}} — maintain a comfortable still position, breathe out slowly; rest 10 sec after both sides.

  • 1 set × 45 sec {{exercise:1346:kneeling lat stretch}} — hold gently with relaxed ribs, breathe out into the position; rest 10 sec.

Breathe quietly for 60 sec: inhale for 4 sec and exhale for 6 sec, without holding your breath.

name: Keystone Press
main_workout:
🧽 Soft Tissue Preparation 2'

  • Foam roll glutes — 30 sec each side; move slowly with gentle contact, avoiding bony areas.

  • Foam roll upper back — 45 sec total; support your head and avoid the neck and lower back.

🔥 Activation 3'

  • 8 reps {{exercise:1167:dynamic chest stretch}} — open and return over 3 sec per rep without forcing the range; rest 15 sec.

  • 8 reps {{exercise:1428:wrist circles}} — smooth, small movements, changing direction halfway; rest 10 sec.

  • 30 sec {{exercise:0669:rear deltoid stretch}} — gently enter and release over 3 sec per rep, without sustained holds; rest 10 sec.

  • 8 reps {{exercise:bird-dog:Bird Dog}} — gently reach and return over 4 sec per rep within a comfortable range; rest 15 sec.

💪 Main Workout (REPS & SETS)

Complete straight sets in the listed order; do not alternate exercises. Use dumbbells and one adjustable bench. Keep 2 reps in reserve throughout. The prescribed work and recovery budget is approximately 40 minutes; use the recovery after each final set to change position and adjust the bench.

  • 5 sets × 4 reps {{exercise:1757:dumbbell single leg deadlift}} — tempo 2-sec lower, 1-sec pause, lift with explosive intent over approximately 1 sec, 1-sec reset; rest 150 sec. Keep knees softly bent, weights close and your spine steady; stop descending before your back position changes.

  • 4 sets × 4 reps {{exercise:0289:dumbbell bench press}} — tempo 2-sec lower, 1-sec pause, lift with explosive intent over approximately 1 sec, 1-sec reset; rest 120 sec. Keep ribs stacked over your pelvis and avoid leaning backward.

  • 4 sets × 4 reps {{exercise:0314:Dumbbell Incline Press}} — tempo 2-sec lower, 1-sec pause, lift with explosive intent over approximately 1 sec, 1-sec reset; rest 120 sec. Set the bench at 30–45 degrees, plant your feet and keep your shoulders supported.

  • 2 sets × 5 reps {{exercise:2137:dumbbell arnold press}} — tempo 2-sec lower, 1-sec pause, lift with explosive intent over approximately 1 sec, 1-sec reset; rest 120 sec. Flatten the bench and keep elbows comfortably near your sides.

  • 1 set × 6 reps {{exercise:1459:dumbbell romanian deadlift}} — tempo 2-sec lower, 1-sec pause, smooth 1-sec extension, 1-sec reset; rest 120 sec. Return the bench to a comfortable incline; use a moderate load and keep upper arms steady.

⚡ Finisher (REPS & SETS)

Approximately 5 minutes. These are three controlled accessory sets, not a circuit or conditioning test. Stay at the same incline bench, use lighter dumbbells and retain 2 clean reps in reserve. Reduce the load for the final exercise as needed to accommodate the additional repetitions.

  • 1 set × 8 reps {{exercise:0596:lever seated fly}} — tempo 2-sec lower, 1-sec comfortable pause, smooth 1-sec return, 1-sec reset; rest 60 sec. Maintain softly bent elbows and stop before the shoulders feel strained.

  • 1 set × 8 reps {{exercise:0334:dumbbell lateral raise}} — tempo 2-sec return, 1-sec pause, smooth 1-sec reach, 1-sec reset; rest 60 sec. Keep elbows straight without locking; use a small shoulder-blade movement rather than bending the arms.

  • 1 set × 8 reps {{exercise:0300:dumbbell deadlift}} — tempo 2-sec lower, 1-sec pause, smooth 1-sec extension, 1-sec reset; rest 60 sec. Keep the movement comfortable at the elbows and finish without grinding.

🧘 Cool Down 4'

  • 1 set × 30 sec each side {{exercise:1271:chest and front of shoulder stretch}} — hold still at mild tension and breathe out into the position; rest 5 sec between sides.

  • 1 set × 30 sec each side {{exercise:1511:hamstring stretch}} — hold still without rounding forcefully or bouncing; rest 5 sec between sides.

  • 1 set × 30 sec each side {{exercise:1424:seated glute stretch}} — hold still and breathe out into the position; rest 5 sec between sides.

  • 2 min Box breathing — 4 in, 4 hold, 4 out, 4 hold
